messages:
julian_csm: Heads up — Zephyr Labs reached out with a request to onboard a 13B legal model for contract review. They want statute-aware redaction + normalized citation output, and insist on HSM-backed keying for any private deploy. cc @maria_cs @nina_research

maria_cs: Got it. Do they require PHI-level protections or just PII/contract-only controls? Also which model artifact are they providing?

julian_csm: No PHI, primarily contract and regulatory text. They named the artifact 'lex-13b-legal-v1' (OSS weights + vendor L2 license). Renewal upsell is paused until we confirm timeline — they'd like an ETA this week.

nina_research: Plan: run a targeted safety+quality suite focusing on three areas: 1) citation-precision (does model cite actual statutes), 2) redaction-recall (are sensitive strings removed), 3) hallucination-rate on statutory claims. Propose 500 annotated docs across CA/NY/UK to start. Example eval command I can run:```bash
run_redwood_eval --suite statute-redaction --model lex-13b-legal-v1 --samples 500 --output s3://zephyr-evals/lex-v1/initial.json
```Will instrument citation links and false-positive flags.

todd_se: Ops note — Private deployment with HSM means Dedicated capacity request. Need latency target from them; if they'd accept ~150ms p95 for typical review flows we can provision smaller pools. Suggest fallback: host a quantized variant (lex-13b-quant) on Hosted API for spikes. Any objections?

julian_csm: No objections. I'll offer 150ms p95 and the hosted fallback option. Nina — can you confirm the eval ETA (doable in 72h?) so I can tell the customer? Maria — I'll send the intake checklist and DPA request today.

deploy-bot: ticket created CS-5821: "Zephyr Labs — lex-13b legal model intake" — https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-5821. Triage scheduled within 24h.

maria_cs: Thanks — pinging legal for the DPA template, and security will loop in HSM key requirements. I'll update CS-5821 with customer contact and procurement notes. :thumbsup:
